q: The tensor product V ⊗ W of vector spaces V and W over a field k has dimension:
exp: dim(V ⊗ W) = dim V · dim W. The tensor product is characterised by the universal property: bilinear maps V × W → Z correspond bijectively to linear maps V ⊗ W → Z. Tensor products of representations, modules, and Hilbert spaces are central in algebra and physics.
